svg.title: package-layers

g.text: Each row: the package on the left may import the packages on the right. Nothing else.
Dependency direction is outer (top) to inner (bottom). Dashed chips are type imports only.
no project imports listed in the root CLAUDE.md

commons and config import nothing from the project.
